name: Lineup square stance
notes: Extracted from 10 cards that carried this sentence inline; edit it here and every one follows.
pose: She stands tall and square to the camera, feet a little apart, one arm relaxed slightly away from her side and the other palm held open at waist height, chin level, a calm, commanding gaze straight to the camera; her full figure from head to toe is visible, centred, filling the frame height with space on all sides; every magical effect stays within arm's reach of her body so she can be cut out cleanly.
